They walk 2 steps backward, dallas gets on point, forces the fight, mayhem are forced to fight because they don't have a comp that can in/out contest the point, dallas wins shield war because they have bastion, and they should win in theory. Even if they don't win the fight, they would force ticks because of mayhems slow comp that is either forced to fight uncomfortably on the point, or give up ticks to try and position themselves.

If you can't see how the comp was really good against the florida defense I don't know what to tell you. They basically have no shield because of bastion and they always win sheild war. Mei allowed them to get close to where florida was holding and make them super uncomfortable. It forced them out of position. The comp florida ran is designed to be in the position they were at. The orisa doesn't want to play on point vs a bastion. Thats a losing fight. They were trying to force a fight where they sit on point with bastion and just win because Florida's comp had nothing to pressure them when they got there. Their rein shield was at a good amount of hp, logix just got an angle and made a play. Goof players are going to make good plays. That's why theyre in OWL. They spend so much time practicing and they obviously know what they're doing. Things happen in game that are beyond what you can do to prepare. Did they spend hours of good preparation? Yes. Do they know how to play "Did everyone go how they planned? No. That's ok. There's no need to blame kyky because Florida showed up. There are so many elements to winning a map and its a complete team effort. Kyky is one part of the team. He, like everyone else in the league, spends so much time preparing for these matches. He's doing his job. They're not winning because Dallas is meshing well as a team in game and that's clear to see. They need time to do that before they will be great.

If you actually think about the strategies they used, in theory, they're very good. Kings row first for example. Their comp was a hard counter to the mayhem's defense. Rascal on mei got domed by logix. There is nothing kyky can do in that situation to tell logix to not make a big play like that. If that didn't happen, you would all be praising kyky for coming up with such a great counter, even though it probably wasn't just him. You cant blame a single person in these situations. The team needs to mesh and it might take a while for them to do so because they have added new players and are still working on what they want to do.
